label: Test by Controls for the typed IMMENSE_2 and INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2 for Whatever is INFINITE_1 is (1)
note: Tests the converse strength implication in the registered interpretation. Same Infinite and Incomprehensible. The strong version gives INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1 to every INFINITE_1 being; the weak one only to such a being that no caused intellect comprehends. Control part 3: an infinite being comprehended by a caused intellect satisfies the weak version and falsifies the strong one. The order concerns the sense bridge alone: given infinity, the weak version together with 'Whatever has its being caused by another is not INFINITE_1' and 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being' entails the strong version again, so the route through the weak version splits the old commitment into finer premises rather than weakening it in total.
